theorem_title: Finite height under an isomorphism of number fields
formal_statement:
theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.finHeight_mapEquiv {T : Type*} [Field T] [NumberField T]
    {T' : Type*} [Field T'] [NumberField T'] (e : T ≃+* T') (y : T) :
    finHeight (e y) = finHeight y := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $T$ and $T'$ be number fields and $e\colon T\simeq T'$ a field isomorphism. For any $y\in T$, define the finite height $h_{\mathrm{fin},T}(y)$ by summing $\max(0,\log|y|_v)$ at the finite places of $T$, with the absolute value supplied by the completion. Then

$$h_{\mathrm{fin},T'}(e(y))=h_{\mathrm{fin},T}(y).$$

This identity transports the finite height of the supplied curve to the given point field.
